counters.name: Clocks
counters.description: Number of GPU clocks

counters.name: % Vertex Fetch Stall
counters.description:
Percentage of clock cycles where the GPU cannot make any more requests for vertex data.
A high value for this metric implies the GPU cannot get vertex data from memory fast enough, and rendering performance may be negatively affected.

counters.name: % Texture Fetch Stall
counters.description:
Percentage of clock cycles where the shader processors cannot make any more requests for texture data.
A high value for this metric implies the shaders cannot get texture data from the texture pipe (L1, L2 cache or memory) fast enough, and rendering performance may be negatively affected.

counters.name: % Texture L1 Miss
counters.description:
Number of L1 texture cache misses divided by L1 texture cache requests.
This metric does not consider how many texture requests are made per time period (like the '% GPU L1 Texture cache miss' metric), but is simple miss to request ratio.

counters.name: % Texture L2 Miss
counters.description:
Number of L2 texture cache misses divided by L2 texture cache requests.
This metric does not consider how many texture requests are made per time period, but is simple miss to request ratio.

counters.name: % Stalled on System Memory
counters.description: Percentage of cycles the L2 cache is stalled waiting for data from system memory.

counters.name: Read Total (Bytes)
counters.description: Total number of bytes read by the GPU from memory.

counters.name: Write Total (Bytes)
counters.description: Total number of bytes written by the GPU to memory.

counters.name: Texture Memory Read BW (Bytes)
counters.description:
Bytes of texture data read from memory.
Includes bytes of platform compressed texture data read from memory.

counters.name: Vertex Memory Read (Bytes)
counters.description: Bytes of vertex data read from memory.

counters.name: SP Memory Read (Bytes)
counters.description: Bytes of data read from memory by the Shader Processors.

counters.name: % Shaders Busy
counters.description: Percentage of time that all Shader cores are busy.

counters.name: % Shaders Stalled
counters.description: Percentage of time that all shader cores are idle with at least one active wave.

counters.name: % Shader ALU Capacity Utilized
counters.description:
Percent of maximum shader capacity (ALU operations) utilized.
For each cycle that the shaders are working, the average percentage of the total shader ALU capacity that is utilized for that cycle.

counters.name: % Time ALUs Working
counters.description: Percentage of time the ALUs are working while the Shaders are busy.

counters.name: % Time EFUs Working
counters.description: Percentage of time the EFUs are working while the Shaders are busy.

counters.name: % Texture Pipes Busy
counters.description: Percentage of time that any texture pipe is busy.

counters.name: % Wave Context Occupancy
counters.description: Average percentage of wave context occupancy per cycle.

counters.name: % Instruction Cache Miss
counters.description: Number of L1 instruction cache misses divided by L1 instruction cache requests.

counters.name: % Time Shading Vertices
counters.description: Amount of time spent shading vertices compared to the total time spent shading everything.

counters.name: Vertices Shaded
counters.description: Number of vertices submitted to the shader engine.

counters.name: Vertex Instructions
counters.description:
Total number of scalar vertex shader instructions issued.
Includes full precision ALU vertex instructions and EFU vertex instructions.  Does not include medium precision instructions (since they are not used for vertex shaders). Does not include vertex fetch or texture fetch instructions.

counters.name: Textures / Vertex
counters.description: Average number of textures referenced per vertex.

counters.name: Avg Bytes / Vertex
counters.description: Average number of bytes transferred from main memory for each vertex.

counters.name: ALU / Vertex
counters.description:
Average number of vertex scalar shader ALU instructions issued per shaded vertex.
Does not include fragment shader instructions.

counters.name: EFU / Vertex
counters.description:
Average number of scalar vertex shader EFU instructions issued per shaded vertex.
Does not include fragment EFU instructions

counters.name: % Time Shading Fragments
counters.description: Amount of time spent shading fragments compared to the total time spent shading everything.

counters.name: Fragments Shaded
counters.description: Number of fragments submitted to the shader engine.

counters.name: Fragment Instructions
counters.description:
Total number of fragment shader instructions issued.
Reported as full precision scalar ALU instructions - 2 medium precision instructions equal 1 full precision instruction. Also includes interpolation instructions (which are executed on the ALU hardware) and EFU (Elementary Function Unit) instructions. Does not include texture fetch instructions.

counters.name: Fragment ALU Instructions (Half)
counters.description:
Total number of half precision Scalar fragment shader instructions issued.
Does not include full precision instructions or texture fetch instructions.

counters.name: Fragment ALU Instructions (Full)
counters.description:
Total number of full precision fragment shader instructions issued.
Does not include medium precision instructions or texture fetch instructions.

counters.name: Fragment EFU Instructions
counters.description:
Total number of Scalar fragment shader Elementary Function Unit (EFU) instructions issued.
These include math functions like sin, cos, pow, etc.

counters.name: L1 Texture Cache Miss Per Pixel
counters.description:
Average number of Texture L1 cache misses per pixel.
Lower values for this metric imply better memory coherency. If this value is high, consider using compressed textures, reducing texture usage, etc.

counters.name: Textures / Fragment
counters.description: Average number of textures referenced per fragment.

counters.name: Avg Bytes / Fragment
counters.description: Average number of bytes transferred from main memory for each fragment.

counters.name: ALU / Fragment
counters.description:
Average number of scalar fragment shader ALU instructions issued per shaded fragment, expressed as full precision ALUs (2 mediump = 1 fullp).
Includes interpolation instruction.  Does not include vertex shader instructions.

counters.name: EFU / Fragment
counters.description:
Average number of scalar fragment shader EFU instructions issued per shaded fragment.
Does not include Vertex EFU instructions

counters.name: % Time Compute
counters.description: Amount of time spent in compute work compared to the total time spent shading everything.

counters.name: Pre-clipped Polygons
counters.description: Number of polygons submitted to the GPU before any hardware clipping.

counters.name: % Prims Trivially Rejected
counters.description:
Percentage of primitives that are trivially rejected.
A primitive can be trivially rejected if it is outside the visible region of the render surface.  These primitives are ignored by the rasterizer.

counters.name: % Prims Clipped
counters.description:
Percentage of primitives clipped by the GPU (where new primitives are generated).
For a primitive to be clipped, it has to have a visible portion inside the viewport but extend outside the 'guardband' - an area that surrounds the viewport and significantly reduces the number of primitives the hardware has to clip.

counters.name: % LRZ Busy
counters.description: Percentage of time the low resolution Z (LRZ) block is busy compared to the total GPU activity.

counters.name: Average Vertices / Polygon
counters.description:
Average number of vertices per polygon.
This will be around 3 for triangles, and close to 1 for triangle strips.

counters.name: Reused Vertices
counters.description:
Number of vertices used from the post-transform vertex buffer cache.
A vertex may be used in multiple primitives; a high value for this metric (compared to number of vertices shaded) indicates good re-use of transformed vertices, reducing vertex shader workload.

counters.name: Average Polygon Area
counters.description:
Average number of pixels per polygon.
Adreno's binning architecture will count a primitive for each 'bin' it covers, so this metric may not exactly match expectations.

counters.name: % Nearest Filtered
counters.description: Percent of texels filtered using the 'Nearest' sampling method.

counters.name: % Linear Filtered
counters.description: Percent of texels filtered using the 'Linear' sampling method.

counters.name: % Anisotropic Filtered
counters.description: Percent of texels filtered using the 'Anisotropic' sampling method.

counters.name: % Non-Base Level Textures
counters.description: Percent of texels coming from a non-base MIP level.

counters.name: Preemptions
counters.description: The number of GPU preemptions that occurred.

counters.name: Avg Preemption Delay
counters.description: Average time (us) from the preemption request to preemption start.

counters.name: % RTU Busy
counters.description: Percentage of time that Ray Tracing Unit in SP is busy compared to whole SP.

counters.name: % BVH Fetch Stall
counters.description: Percentage of clock cycles where the RTU could not make any more requests for BVH fetch from scheduler. High value for this metric implies the RTU cannot fetch BVH nodes fast enough and performance may be negatively affected.

counters.name: Average BVH Fetch Latency Cycles
counters.description: The Average BVH Fetch Latency cycles is the latency counted from start of BVH query request till getting BVH Query result back. We want this value to be much less than the RTU Busy cycles to know that there is no bottleneck present for BVH nodes fetch.

counters.name: RTU Ray Triangle Intersections Per Instruction
counters.description: Number of Ray Triangle intersections per instruction.

counters.name: RTU Ray Box Intersections Per Instruction
counters.description: Number of Ray Box intersections per instruction.

counters.name: Surface Write Ratio
counters.description: Ratio of fragments shaded to surface area (fragments per pixel)

counters.name: LRZ Prims Killed
counters.description: Number of primitives killed as a result of low resolution Z (LRZ) tests.

counters.name: LRZ Pixels Killed
counters.description: Number of pixels killed as a result of low resolution Z (LRZ) tests. This metric will approach 0 when LRZ is not able to be utilized for any reason.
